razonamiento: The architecture shows an automated image ingestion and processing pipeline. Drones upload imagery to a third-party processing system. CloudWatch initiates an AWS Step Functions workflow consisting of three Lambda functions: Lambda 1 checks the third-party API, Lambda 2 fetches the images and stores them in S3, and Lambda 3 generates raster proxies and writes metadata/proxies to an on-premises database. On-premises mapping software accesses S3 images via AWS Storage Gateway. All 10 components from the visual reading (including 3 distinct Lambdas) and narration match accurately.
nombre: Drone Imagery Processing and On-Premises Synchronization Pipeline
